axis: SAR filing deadline: alerts with an identified subject vs an unidentified subject
rule_template: A bank investigating <<CATEGORY_A>> suspicious activity alert must file a Suspicious Activity Report within <<THRESHOLD_A>> <<UNIT>> of the initial detection, and a bank investigating <<CATEGORY_B>> suspicious activity alert must file a Suspicious Activity Report within <<THRESHOLD_B>> <<UNIT>> of the initial detection.

The bank's BSA officer submitted the Suspicious Activity Report <<VALUE>> <<UNIT>> after the alert was generated. The transfers totaled approximately $180,000 across eleven transactions.
scenario_template_b: Cobalt Trust Bank's monitoring system flagged a series of rapid transfers through a customer account, and investigators were unable to confirm the identity of the party initiating the transfers despite extended inquiry. The bank's BSA officer submitted the Suspicious Activity Report <<VALUE>> <<UNIT>> after the alert was generated. The transfers totaled approximately $180,000 across eleven transactions.
